authority: Existing guide policy explicitly reiterated by coordinator: actual factual evidence in the same response counts; bare section labels do not.
generic_added_sentence: Consider the whole local response, including actual factual clauses in its evidence field. A bare section label or citation does not supply an omitted rule; factual evidence in the same response may resolve a part, but cannot erase a materially false contradictory claim.
historical_scope_work: No broad retrospective campaign; only requested11Q32 neutral case review.
